source.provider: NOAA NCEI / Dauphin Island Sea Lab
source.sampling: hydro hourly at varied depths; met 1 minute

verified_limits: NOAA explicitly reports hydrographic instrument failure after July 3; subsequent months contain no authoritative hydro observations in this accession.
NOAA DO mg/L and DO percent are separate measurements and must never be silently cross-interpreted.
NOAA's Water Height text labels units 'meters per second' while describing instrument-to-surface distance in meters: block this variable pending native-file verification.
Provider QC metadata codes: 0/blank unevaluated; 1 bad; 2 questionable; 3 good; -9 null. Missing or ambiguous QC must not be converted to valid.
Different measurement depths are described, but instrument heights above bed and datum have not been authenticated from native records.
The described dataset is not an ADCP observed-current source and does not clear Y1.x122.038:0002 calibration.
